client.business_model: Multi-state provider of home health, hospice and rehabilitation therapy services
client.client_history: Founded in 2007 by physical therapist David Jackson in Tyler, Texas, Choice Health at Home has expanded through organic growth and a series of acquisitions to serve patients across Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas and Louisiana. The company partnered with private-equity firms Trive Capital and Coltala Holdings in 2021 to accelerate its regional expansion.

revenue.notes: No credible public source or document in the provided materials states company revenue.

locations.notes: Company website and provided documents mention operations in several states but do not specify the number of branch offices or care locations.

employees.source: LinkedIn company page (linkedin.com/company/choicehealthathome) shows 1,001-5,000 employees; Bitscale.ai profile (bitscale.ai/directory/choice-health-at-home) lists 86 employees.
employees.notes: Significant discrepancy between sources. LinkedIn range suggests a large field-based workforce typical for home-health providers, while Bitscale likely reflects corporate headcount only. Using the lower bound of the LinkedIn range as a conservative estimate.
